name: Exorcism
overview: The Scriptures reveal that exorcism involves the authoritative casting out of unclean spirits, as demonstrated when Jesus commanded an evil spirit to come out of a man (Mark 5:8) and permitted the spirits to enter a herd of swine (Mark 5:13). The New Testament also records instances of individuals afflicted by evil spirits, such as a boy with a dumb spirit brought to Jesus for healing (Mark 9:17) and highlights the concern over those casting out demons in Jesus' name without following His disciples (Mark 9:38). These passages affirm the reality of spiritual warfare and the necessity of faith in Christ for salvation (Mark 16:16), underscoring the power and authority given through Him to overcome demonic forces.
